title: Testing Exponential f(R) Gravity with CMB, DESI-DR2, and Supernova Data
efc_relevance: Exponential f(R) lowers H0 (no relaxation) and raises S8 by ~1.2σ on the joint CMB+DESI-DR2+SN dataset — opposite sign on H0 from EFC's L2/L3 prediction and same sign on S8 as the fragile η-boost branch (DOI 32037990, 0% robust) rather than the robust EFC branch. Sharpens FA2 µ-sign discriminator and constrains the f(R) scalaron domain.
ledger_action: Add to Gap Analysis as mod-gravity contrast row; cross-reference framework:fR-Starobinsky2007 and arXiv:2604.23631 (CLASH-VLT chameleon); required FA2 µ-sign comparison and reference baseline for EFC's robust S8 ≈ 0.82 branch.
